explanation: This fires only at D1, when the previous trial was rewarded and the agent has been choosing a2 for at least two trials in a row (the reward still counts if that a2 trial had a rare transition). It is about 8-10 after trial 60, about 3-5 around trials 45-60, and 0 before that; it is 0 at every GO and D2 step, at D1 after an unrewarded trial, and whenever the agent has been choosing a1.
